messages: It doesn't seem easy to talk to #p309#.

I met #p309# in #m10002000#, and he REALLY doesn't seem to like people. As a whole. How did he and Icarus become best friends in the first place? Anyway, in order to make the #b#t4031079##k, he needs #b50 #t4000039##k and #b20 #t4031012#s#k. That's really all it takes to fly?
As #p309# asked, I got him the #t4000039# and #t4031012# items. Can he make the #t4031079# with these?
